title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^121.993

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 (declared conditional bound 0.5025, proof.md sections 3 and 7) under heuristics H1-H5 and the disclosed H6 relation input (section 9). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^121.993 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (section 8) totals 2^121.992667. Relation collection keeps the frontier's 2601/2500 work and 2401/2500 yield brackets; f-side ECM cofactor slack 295 (cofactors <= 303 bits), g-side slack 226 (cofactors <= 234 bits), each side priced by the explicit ecm16.py schedule at 99% (2^37.5177 / 2^37.5150). Trial division covers every prime below 2^34 at a charged 600 instructions per prime (pi(2^34) <= 2^34/(ln 2^34 - 1.1) = 2^29.510, Rosser-Schoenfeld), so the per-survivor norm/trial-division/ECM charge is 2^39.632. Retained yield 2^64.254, 0.424 bits above 1.3 U. The line sieve covers p in [2^8,2^40) and the record walk p in [2^40,2^63); every line-sieved hit with p >= 2^34 is emitted as a record and charged 36 routing + 7.00 apply + 7.003 recovery per record, so factors above trial division are recovered and divided out before ECM (section 3, check [5d]). The descent input is LOG2_RELS = 64.130 = floor(2^64.2541 - 1.05 x 0.1175), an epistemic haircut; no yield-survival probability is charged, and the declared success 0.5025 is conditional on the fixed production supply reaching it (H6). The boot keeps 8 relations (psi^8 = 2.1438e-02, psi = 0.61858, charged twice); two-log expectation 2^117.951, metered cap 2^119.14 (directed Markov 2^-1.189; exact 2^-1.18908). Linear algebra (26,5) blocks at 88/97 per entry, pad 1.61. Preprocessing is inside the total; no external advice, nothing amortized. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
